title: Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space
code_status: 官方项目页https://chenshuo20.github.io/PixVid/出现GitHub/Hugging Face文字但无可核验源码/权重链接；固定v1未找到已发布原作者仓库。
code_license: 源码未找到；论文arXiv perpetual non-exclusive license

cost_assessment.source: Fixed v1 Sections 4/5 and Appendices; https://arxiv.org/html/2611.17336v1
cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.model_scale: Wan2.1-14B; additional 1.3B ablations and pixel detailer
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: About 1.3M training clips, 20k updates; B200 inference with 50 denoising steps and CFG. 960x1664/21 frames requires 53.6GB and 192 seconds per clip in the paper.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Full video training and resolution/sampling/ablation matrices are high cost; even fitting a large single inference in memory does not make this campaign affordable.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅资料收录，不下载权重或视频，不以普通flow loss冒充PixVid完整架构。

summary: 将预训练latent视频DiT通过离线像素-潜空间线性对齐、时间步校准和新增时空detailer迁移到像素空间，并用patch初始化与时序正则控制高分辨率细节。仅资料收录；14B视频训练与B200完整评测成本过高，不复现（审查DONE）。
deferral_reason: 14B视频模型、约130万训练clip和B200采样矩阵超出单卡短时预算；成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）。
